title: Decor
description: Preference manifest for the Decor wallpaper picker. Use with Jamf Pro's Application & Custom Settings payload to push managed preferences to techtherapy.decor.

wallpapersPath.title: Wallpapers Path
wallpapersPath.description: Absolute path to the directory containing wallpaper images. Tilde paths are expanded.

logoTitle.title: Logo Title
logoTitle.description: Title displayed next to the logo in the header. Leave empty to omit.

logoPath.title: Logo Path (Light Mode)
logoPath.description: Absolute path to a logo image shown in the header in light mode. Leave empty to omit.

logoPathDark.title: Logo Path (Dark Mode)
logoPathDark.description: Absolute path to a logo image shown in the header in dark mode. Leave empty to omit.

launchPosition.title: Launch Position
launchPosition.description: Where the window appears on screen when Decor launches.

defaultColumnCount.title: Default Column Count
defaultColumnCount.description: Number of columns the launch window opens at. Clamped to 1–20.

defaultRowCount.title: Default Row Count
defaultRowCount.description: Number of rows the launch window opens at. Clamped to 1–20.

hideOtherAppsOnLaunch.title: Hide Other Apps On Launch
hideOtherAppsOnLaunch.description: Hide all other applications when Decor launches, so the picker is the only thing visible.

doubleClickToSetWallpaper.title: Double-Click To Set Wallpaper
doubleClickToSetWallpaper.description: If enabled, double-clicking a thumbnail sets the wallpaper directly and quits, skipping the preview step.

thumbnailSize.title: Thumbnail Size
thumbnailSize.description: Width in points of each wallpaper thumbnail. Clamped to 100–400.

maxThumbnailsPerRow.title: Max Thumbnails Per Row
maxThumbnailsPerRow.description: Hard cap on grid columns regardless of window width. Clamped to 2–20.

gridSpacing.title: Grid Spacing
gridSpacing.description: Spacing in points between grid cells. Clamped to 4–32.

cornerRadius.title: Corner Radius
cornerRadius.description: Corner radius in points for thumbnail cards. Clamped to 0–24.

shadowRadius.title: Shadow Radius
shadowRadius.description: Shadow radius in points for thumbnail cards. Clamped to 0–10.

showWallpaperInfo.title: Show Wallpaper Info
showWallpaperInfo.description: Show the filename underneath each thumbnail.

showCollectionTitles.title: Show Collection Titles
showCollectionTitles.description: Show the section header (folder name and underline) above each collection. When false, wallpapers are still grouped by subfolder but the title is hidden.

textHighlightColor.title: Text Highlight Color
textHighlightColor.description: Hex color used for the selected wallpaper's text.

thumbnailHighlightColor.title: Thumbnail Highlight Color
thumbnailHighlightColor.description: Hex color (e.g. #007AFF) used to outline the selected thumbnail.
